data.one_liner: Simulate color blindness across Material 3 color schemes or individual colors in Flutter.
data.what_it_does: It simulates eight color vision deficiencies (such as deuteranopia, protanopia, and tritanopia) on individual colors or complete Material 3 color schemes. It also calculates color contrast ratios and checks contrast issues to audit accessibility.
use_when: You need to audit your app's Material 3 theme and colors for accessibility against color blindness.
You want to preview how your UI looks under different color vision deficiencies.
avoid_when: You require rigorous physiological LMS cone-space simulations (like Brettel or Machado models) instead of lightweight 3x3 RGB matrix approximations.
strengths: Supports eight distinct color vision deficiencies.
Works directly with Material 3 ColorSchemes and individual Flutter Colors.
Includes built-in contrast ratio checking and accessibility auditing tools.
weaknesses: Uses lightweight sRGB matrix approximations rather than physiological cone-space modeling.
Limited to color simulation and contrast checking utilities.
data.setup_notes: No native setup or permissions required. Simply add the dependency and import the package.
